description.value:
Requirement You are in irradiated or heavily corrupted terrain.

Duration constant

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, and you cannot be surprised by a creature native to or long resident in that terrain.

rules.label: In irradiated or heavily corrupted terrain

cinderfall.incomplete: Requires irradiated/heavily corrupted terrain: +2 circumstance to initiative (built above via a player-toggled RollOption feeding a predicated FlatModifier, matching real pf2e's Twitchy, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/goblin/level-1/twitchy.json:28-57 -- a player-toggled flag standing in for a GM-judged situational fact). The second clause, "can't be surprised by a creature native to or long resident in that terrain," is NOT built: no rule element gates surprise/being-unable-to-be-surprised by an enemy's origin/residency; PF2e's surprise mechanic isn't exposed to system.rules at that granularity.
